versions.content: Main source of information on BSW Module ECU Configu- ration activity and integration Type: valid Description: The BSWMD template SHALL provide means to describe - or reference to - the information needed for ECU Configuration activity and integration of a BSW module or cluster of BSW modules. This description formats SHALL be used for the ECU Configuration activity and integration along with the relevant BSW SWS documents. Rationale: By selecting the BSWMD of a BSW module's implementation, the necessary information for the ECU Configuration activity and integration of that module SHALL be available. When delivering several BSW modules in a cluster the BSWMD template SHALL support the integration of this cluster. However this description format might not formalize all aspects needed for taking integration decisions (e.g. scheduling). Dependencies: [RS_BSWMD_00014] 5 40 of 47  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 86: AUTOSAR_RS_BSWModuleDescriptionTemplate Requirements on Basic Software Module Description Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Use Case: To be able to exchange BSW modules from different vendors only the specified information can be used during the integration. Supporting Material: 
